_comment: PocketMCP - MCP server config for Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, Windsurf, etc.
_instructions: 1. Replace YOUR_PHONE_IP with your Android device's local IP (shown in the app)
2. Replace YOUR_API_KEY with the key from the app (or remove the headers block if auth is off)
3. Claude Code requires "type": "http"; Cursor ignores it; OpenCode uses mcp.servers instead of mcpServers
4. Easiest path: run `node mcp-bridge/setup.mjs` — it writes correct configs for your tools, or prints them via `setup.mjs print generic`
5. Stdio-only clients (Claude Desktop, Windsurf, Cline): use command "node" with args ["<repo>/mcp-bridge/bridge.mjs"] instead of the url
